<?php
class SensitivePromotedValue23 {
    public \Error $error;
    public function __construct(#[\SensitiveParameter] public int $secret, public int $visible) {
        $secret = 17;
        $this->error = new \Error("E");
    }
}
$object = new SensitivePromotedValue23(7, 9);
$error = $object->error;
$arguments = $error->getTrace()[0]["args"];
echo $object->secret, "|", $arguments[0]->getValue(), "|", $arguments[1], "|", $error->getTraceAsString();

<?php
class SensitivePromotedReference23 {
    public \Error $error;
    public function __construct(#[\SensitiveParameter] public int &$secret) {
        $this->secret = 17;
        $this->error = new \Error("E");
    }
}
$secret = 7;
$object = new SensitivePromotedReference23($secret);
$error = $object->error;
$wrapper = $error->getTrace()[0]["args"][0];
echo $secret, "|", $object->secret, "|", $wrapper->getValue(), "|";
$secret = 23;
echo $secret, "|", $object->secret, "|", $wrapper->getValue(), "|", $error->getTraceAsString();

<?php
namespace SensitiveAlias23;
use SensitiveParameter as Mask;
class Box {
    public \Error $error;
    public function __construct(#[mAsK] public int $secret) { $secret = 17; $this->error = new \Error("E"); }
}
$box = new Box(7);
echo $box->secret, "|", $box->error->getTrace()[0]["args"][0]->getValue();

<?php
class SensitiveReadonly23 {
    public \Error $error;
    public function __construct(#[\SensitiveParameter] public readonly int $secret) { $secret = 17; $this->error = new \Error("E"); }
}
$object = new SensitiveReadonly23(7);
echo $object->secret, "|", $object->error->getTrace()[0]["args"][0]->getValue(), "|";
try { $object->__construct(23); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo "R|", $error->getTrace()[0]["args"][0]->getValue(), "|", $object->secret; }

<?php
class SensitiveParent23 {
    public \Error $error;
    public function __construct(#[\SensitiveParameter] private int $secret) { $secret = 17; $this->error = new \Error("E"); }
    public function reveal() { return $this->secret; }
}
class SensitiveChild23 extends SensitiveParent23 {}
$object = new SensitiveChild23(7);
echo $object->reveal(), "|", $object->error->getTrace()[0]["args"][0]->getValue();

<?php
trait SensitiveTrait23 {
    public \Error $error;
    public function __construct(#[\SensitiveParameter] private int $secret) { $secret = 17; $this->error = new \Error("E"); }
    public function reveal() { return $this->secret; }
}
class SensitiveTraitUser23 { use SensitiveTrait23; }
$object = new SensitiveTraitUser23(7);
echo $object->reveal(), "|", $object->error->getTrace()[0]["args"][0]->getValue();

<?php
class SensitiveVariadic23 {
    public function __construct(#[\SensitiveParameter] public int ...$secret) { echo "BODY"; }
}
echo "AFTER";

<?php
class SensitiveOutside23 {
    public function f(#[\SensitiveParameter] public int $secret = 1, $required) { echo "BODY"; }
}
echo "AFTER";
